text:
maria: hitting weird DNS timeouts from edge pools when model-loader tries to pull weights, 504s and socket timeouts in the fetch logs. Not all nodes, maybe 30% of us in eu-west-1.
sam: ugh. are those from pod logs or the load balancer?
maria: pod logs. stacktrace shows `getaddrinfo` hanging ~5s then failing. snippet: `Failed to resolve model-host.internal: timeout`
kevin: any recent changes to resolv.conf / systemd-resolved?
maria: we rolled out the split-horizon host override for model-host.internal last night (works in control plane), but only in the private recursors.
anya: model-loader does a lot of concurrent lookups during cold-start (hundreds of identical hostname hits). Could be fanout.
juan: sending a quick `dig` from a bad node shows `;; got SERVFAIL` from our edge forwarder, but forwarder responds fine from a good node.
maria: I collected `resolv.conf` from 6 nodes, the bad ones have `127.0.0.53` (systemd stub) first, then `options ndots:0`. Good ones point directly to our local forwarder IP.
sam: so systemd-resolved stub on some nodes, direct forwarder on others. how did that happen?
kevin: onboarding script that configures the stub was changed; it landed on a subset of k8s nodes after a kubelet restart.
anya: systemd-resolved does per-process queueing and retries, and with 200 concurrent identical lookups it ends up serializing. That explains the 5s hangs.
juan: also noticed our forwarder was rate-limiting (we saw `rcode: 2` and `rcode: 5` intermittently) to upstream because TTLs for some records are 0 so forwarder queries auth too often.
maria: logs from the forwarder show a flood to the authoritative, which then started returning SERVFAIL under load. chain reaction.
kevin: action 1: switch bad nodes to point to local forwarder (remove stub) — rolling patch in progress.
sam: action 2: add a small positive cache on the host (nscd/dnsmasq) to coalesce same-name bursts from model-loader.
anya: action 3: update model-loader to jitter and use a shared DNS client with singleflight coalescing for concurrent resolves. I'll prep a small PR.
juan: action 4: temporarily raise forwarder query rate limits and add upstream retry/backoff to reduce SERVFAIL cascade. Ops will coordinate.
maria: quick mitigation: I kicked systemd-resolved on 4 bad nodes (`systemctl restart systemd-resolved`) — two improved immediately, two still see timeouts.
kevin: can you paste `strace -e network` on a bad pod when it hangs? maybe to see whether it's stuck in getaddrinfo or blocked on socket.
maria: attaching excerpts.
maria: ```
getaddrinfo("model-host.internal", "443", {ai_flags=AI_ADDRCONFIG|AI_NUMERICSERV, ...}, 0x7ffd...) = -2 EAI_NONAME (Name or service not known)
poll([{fd=3, events=POLLIN}], 1, 5000) = 0 (Timeout)
```
